verdict.rationale: Notte clearly offers a hosted API (Bearer-token auth, remote cloud browsers, 'deploy your scripts as API endpoints' with invoke/schedule) and natural-language task submission (notte-gh-1, notte-docs-2, notte-docs-17, notte-docs-1), so an agent can submit tasks without managing its own browser. However, no evidence explicitly documents a polling endpoint or webhook callback mechanism for retrieving results, and probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec, leaving the exact async result-delivery contract unverified; a community report also shows a real-world extraction task failing outright. Missing for 10: explicit docs on result polling/webhook callbacks, a published OpenAPI/reference confirming request-response lifecycle, and independent corroboration that async task completion works reliably.
